Gorilla Trekking

Gorilla Trekking

Bwindi Impenetrable Forest & Mgahinga

Trek into the misty forests of Bwindi or Mgahinga to spend one magical hour face-to-face with mountain gorilla families in the wild.

Our expert guides have decades of experience. Permits are limited — book early to secure your spot.

Habituated gorilla families
1 hour with the gorillas
Expert UWA certified guides
UNESCO World Heritage Forest
Gorilla tracking certificate

Wildlife Safari

Wildlife Safari

Queen Elizabeth NP, Murchison Falls & Lake Mburo

Game drives across Uganda's savannah parks: Queen Elizabeth, Murchison Falls, Lake Mburo — lions, elephants, hippos, giraffes and over 600 bird species.

The Kazinga Channel boat cruise offers one of Africa's most spectacular wildlife viewing experiences — with exceptional hippo, crocodile and waterbird density.

Big Five game drives
Kazinga Channel cruise
Tree-climbing lions of Ishasha
600+ bird species
Nile River boat trips

Mountain Adventures

Mountain Adventures

Kilimanjaro, Rwenzori Mountains & Mount Kenya

Conquer Kilimanjaro, the Rwenzori Mountains of the Moon, or Mount Kenya — guided by our certified high-altitude experts.

Our certified mountaineering guides have led hundreds of successful summits with strong safety protocols throughout every ascent.

Mount Kilimanjaro 5,895m
Rwenzori Margherita Peak 5,109m
Mount Kenya 5,199m
Certified guides & porters
Full logistics included

Cultural Tours

Cultural Tours

Buganda, Ankole, Karamoja & Batwa Communities

Immerse in the kingdoms, traditions, and communities of Uganda — from Buganda to Karamoja, Ankole to Batwa.

Our cultural tours prioritise authentic, respectful engagement with local communities including traditional meals, storytelling and visits to royal palaces.

Batwa forest community

Birding Safaris

Birding Safaris

1,000+ Species — Shoebill & Albertine Rift Endemics

Uganda is a birder's paradise with 1,000+ species. Spot the elusive shoebill, African green broadbill, and rare Albertine Rift endemics.

Our specialist birding guides take you to Mabamba swamp, Kibale Forest, and Bwindi for the finest birding Uganda offers.

1,000+ bird species
Shoebill stork specialist trips
Mabamba swamp birding
Albertine Rift endemics
Expert naturalist guides
